meta.title: GovVoice Rwanda — Citizen Feedback & Complaint System
meta.description: Submit complaints, suggestions and compliments to Rwandan government offices. Track responses in Kinyarwanda, English or French.

home.hero_title: Your voice. Your community. A better Rwanda.
home.hero_subtitle: Submit complaints, suggestions and compliments directly to the right government office. Track every step, get real answers, and help build a Rwanda that works for everyone.
home.hero_note: Secure. Multilingual. Open to every citizen.
home.hero_card_subtitle: Follow your case from receipt to resolution.
home.hero_card_update: Your case has been assigned to the infrastructure team.
home.hero_float_body: A district officer replied to your case.
home.why_subtitle: One trusted place to speak up, follow up and see change happen in your community.
home.why_1_desc: Your feedback is routed to the district and department responsible for the issue.
home.why_2_desc: Follow your case in real time with a clear status history and expected response time.
home.why_3_desc: Share publicly to inspire change, or keep your submission private to you and the responsible office.
home.why_4_desc: Automatic reminders and escalations keep every case moving until it is resolved.
home.how_title: From voice to resolution in four steps
home.how_subtitle: A simple, accountable path that works in the language you choose.
home.step_1_desc: Register with your National ID and select your province, district and sector.
home.step_2_desc: Choose complaint, suggestion or compliment. Add details, photos or a PDF.
home.step_3_desc: Track progress and communicate with the responsible office from your dashboard.
home.step_4_desc: Tell us if the issue is truly resolved. Reopen it if it is not.
home.testimonials_subtitle: Real change starts when citizens are heard.
home.testimonial_1_quote: I reported a broken water pipe near our sector office. The district replied the next day and the repair team arrived that week.
home.testimonial_2_quote: The best part is seeing every update. I knew exactly who was handling my case and when to expect an answer.
home.testimonial_3_quote: Our suggestion about street lighting was published on the public portal. Six weeks later, the lights were installed.
home.faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know before you share your voice.
home.faq_a1: You can submit a complaint about a public service, a suggestion to improve your community, or a compliment for a service or staff member that made a difference.
home.faq_q2: How do I track my submission?
home.faq_a2: You receive a tracking number immediately after submitting. Use it on the Track page, or sign in to see all your submissions and their latest status in your dashboard.
home.faq_a3: If you choose Public, your submission appears on the public portal without your personal details. If you choose Private, it is visible only to you and the responsible government officials.
home.faq_q4: What happens if I am not satisfied?
home.faq_a4: You can reopen a resolved or closed case within 30 days and explain why. The responsible office is notified and must respond again.
home.faq_q5: Is GovVoice free, and which languages are available?
home.faq_a5: Yes, the platform is free for all citizens. The entire interface and SMS notifications are available in Kinyarwanda, English and French.
home.cta_final: Ready to make your voice count?
home.cta_final_subtitle: It takes less than five minutes to submit feedback that can improve public services for your whole community.

modal.terms_body: GovVoice Rwanda is provided for legitimate citizen feedback. Do not submit false information, abusive content or another person’s personal data. Submissions may be shared with responsible government institutions. Fraudulent use may lead to account suspension.
modal.privacy_body: We collect your National ID, contact details and location to verify your identity, route your feedback and keep you informed. Your personal details are never shown on the public portal. Data is stored securely and accessed only by authorised officials and platform administrators.
